agent_explanation: Fast large body (r~1.15, speed~48) first touches the bottom-left corner of the thin wall (w~0.255) at step 15 (distance -0.10, below wall bottom y~2.54). No wall impulse is applied: vx stays 37.06 from step 15 to 16. The corner contact is missed/mis-resolved, so the body continues to step 16 where it is vertically aligned with the wall side and deeply embedded (overlap 1.08). Likely cause is corner-vs-face handling for thin boxes failing to generate a repulsive impulse/positional correction.
